mintAuthority.summary: USDQ is minted when users borrow against overcollateralized CDPs (wETH/wstETH/weETH/SCR) in Quill's Liquity-v2/BOLD fork on Scroll; minting is restricted to registered branch contracts. USDQ is a UUPS token controlled through QuillAccessManager. The AccessManager is an ERC-1967 proxy whose current verified implementation exposes no UUPS upgrade entrypoint. ADMIN_ROLE of the AccessManager is held by a Gnosis Safe 1.4.1 (0x32fd58b8, 3-of-6, has a guard at 0x075233a1), making token logic mutable through multisig-controlled roles.

controls.label: Liquity-v2 BoldToken branch minters (BorrowerOperations/ActivePool/StabilityPool)
controls.capDescription: Registered BorrowerOperations minting checks current branch debt against the collateral-registry cap, which Quill admin controls can update. Registered ActivePool interest minting bypasses that cap check.
controls.evidence: Re-verified at Scroll block 35235180 on 2026-10-01: the USDQ EIP-1967 implementation remains 0x4103155fb2dcf8b6138c8eb4be0542facc9a7523, the correct EIP-1967 admin slot is zero, and authority() returns 0xbe589551397d0f28255e429ddb478620b1c2f08a. The fetched verified implementation restricts minting to registered BorrowerOperations or ActivePool callers; BorrowerOperations minting checks the branch debt cap, while ActivePool interest minting is exempt from that check.

controls.label: QuillAccessManager (ERC-1967 proxy, admin = Quill Safe multisig)
controls.evidence: At Scroll block 34053392: AccessManager (0xBe589551) used implementation 0x3e5462da8e6c3971d445d717c389a8bec036b719, 'QuillAccessManagerUpgradeable'. ADMIN_ROLE (id=0) was granted to Safe 0x32fd58b8 at deployment (block 15218053); deployer revoked its own role at block 15218072 per on-chain transaction history. Re-verified at block 35235180 on 2026-10-01: the implementation is unchanged, the Safe remains a role-0 member with a 7200-second execution delay and a role-2 member with a 300-second execution delay, and the USDQ upgradeToAndCall selector maps to role 2. These are this member's delays, not a complete census of all upgrade-authorized members.

controls.label: Quill admin Safe multisig (holds ADMIN_ROLE in AccessManager)
controls.evidence: At Scroll block 34053392: getOwners() returned 6 addresses, slot3=6 (ownerCount), slot4=3 (threshold). masterCopy at slot0=0x29fcb43b46531bca003ddc8fcb67ffe91900c762 (VERSION=1.4.1). getModules() returned empty array. Guard storage slot=0x075233a13896b064f19eb3cdeaa2fb03e3457726 (contract with 2640-byte code). Fallback handler=0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99. The deployer EOA (0x9b8d3e60) is owner 6 but is not the sole ADMIN_ROLE holder in the AccessManager. Re-verified at block 35235180 on 2026-10-01: getOwners() retains the same six owners, getThreshold() remains 3, getModulesPaginated() returns no modules, and the guard storage address is unchanged. Version, fallback-handler and guard bytecode observations remain historical.

review.evidence: Re-verified at Scroll block 35235180 on 2026-10-01: USDQ is a UUPS token (implementation 0x4103155fb2dcf8b6138c8eb4be0542facc9a7523, EIP-1967 admin slot zero) whose authority is QuillAccessManager 0xbe589551397d0f28255e429ddb478620b1c2f08a. AccessManager uses implementation 0x3e5462da8e6c3971d445d717c389a8bec036b719 and a zero EIP-1967 admin slot. Its verified proxy is ERC1967Proxy; the verified implementation inherits AccessManagerUpgradeable without UUPSUpgradeable and exposes no upgradeToAndCall entrypoint. The earlier claim that the AccessManager itself is UUPS is removed. Safe 0x32fd58b8c4d454ab585dea736b7d2b5929b6676c retains six owners, threshold 3, no modules and guard 0x075233a13896b064f19eb3cdeaa2fb03e3457726. This Safe's role-0 execution delay is 7200 seconds and role-2 execution delay is 300 seconds; USDQ upgradeToAndCall maps to role 2. No universal minimum upgrade delay is inferred without a complete role-member census. The deployer retains a Safe signer seat. Registered BorrowerOperations minting is debt-cap checked, while ActivePool interest minting bypasses that cap. No prudential supervisor or independent issuance attestor is established.
